title: Claude Code security fix stops unintended API key leakage to Anthropic

The issue affected users routing Claude Code through third-party gateways or proxies.
takeaways: Vulnerability sent gateway API keys on five request types to Anthropic servers
Triggered when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL configured to point at third-party gateway or proxy
Fixed in version 2.1.299 released October 14 at 00:23 UTC
Also fixed: 180-second stream abortion (extended to 300 seconds), prompt-too-long errors near 200,000 tokens
Agent teammate credential fragments issue fixed; no CVE assigned
